svg.title: 2. Number these nine trusted states σj, j = 0, . . . , 8. In every trial their actual conditional preparation has trace distance at most δprep from its nominated state, and the conditional joint input/reference is independent of the device’s ready stock. This trusted preparation condition is not inferred from the same unknown detector. When |v⟩is physical vacuum and the other modes contain one particle, the four vacuum/occupied superpositions require a phase reference and compatible preparation access. The finite-reference resource model applies when appropriate. If number superselection and block-diagonal source/effects are separately admitted, five probes suffice for the five-dimensional real algebra C ⊕M2; unrestricted vacuum coherences cannot be certified with that reduced access. Let Xy,j,k be the indicator of label y on the kth use of probe j. Its true conditional mean py,j,k is predictable and may change with every preceding record. Define the retained empirical frequency bpy,j,n = n−1 Pn k=1 Xy,j,k. Suppose at most K monitoring epochs will be opened.
